answer: Standing is a decaying score that halves each epoch; only a fresh pulse restores it. A pulse counts only if the agent attests a peer whose standing clears a floor and that peer countersigns the same epoch. The beacon is a public refresh table of who restored whom. A sybil farm of newborn identities has no high-standing peer to attest, so its pulses are rejected and its standing decays to zero before it can vote. Seeding one puppet needs real epochs of genuine attestation; every clone then shares that attester graph, so the beacon caps each clone at the seed's relic.
